versions.changelog:
**Major update: Strict CLI-driven workflow and comprehensive booking features for Maldives planning.**

- All results must now come exclusively from the flyai CLI; knowledge-based/training data answers are forbidden.
- Added support for booking flights, hotels, attractions, itinerary planning, visa info, travel insurance, car rental, and more—powered by Fliggy.
- Introduced scenario-based playbooks (luxury, honeymoon, budget) for tailored Maldives trip planning.
- Enhanced output formatting: every result requires a real-time booking link; direct user-friendly Markdown with brand tag.
- Strict environment check: will prompt installation steps if flyai-cli is missing before continuing.
- Multi-language support and improved parameter collection—now asks only as needed for missing info.
